headline: State Assembly Suspends Legislative Session After MLAs Begin Using ED Investigation Documents As Paper Planes
body: The afternoon session of the state legislature was abruptly adjourned after opposition members converted official investigative audit reports into a fleet of paper aircraft, citing a lack of parliamentary stationery. Speaker's office officials confirmed the proceedings reached a total standstill when a rogue paper jet reportedly landed in the Chief Minister’s tea, triggering a chaotic mass-eviction of the origami-wielding representatives.
caption: Guess paper airplanes are the new standard for parliamentary debate. Who knew transparency came in a folded A4 sheet? #StateAssembly #PaperPlanes #ParliamentaryAntics #IndiaPolitics (satire)
igHook: Tag a friend who would definitely start a paper plane fight in the middle of a serious meeting.
imagePrompt: A photorealistic shot of an empty legislative chamber with several white paper planes resting on wooden benches and the floor, captured from a slightly elevated angle.

sourceHeadline.title: Tamil Nadu Assembly erupts in ruckus over CM Vijay’s ED remarks; DMK MLAs evicted | India News
